description: Custom fields that enforce the Definition of Ready (DoR) before a Story can move to READY_FOR_DEV / IN_PROGRESS. Some fields already exist from Phase 1 (config/jira-custom-fields.json) - the setup script checks before creating and skips existing fields.

created_field_ids._note: Created via create_phase3_fields.py on 2026-07-30 against nksaidev.atlassian.net

custom_fields.name: User Story
custom_fields.description: As a [role], I want [feature], so that [benefit]
custom_fields.help_text: Write the user story in the standard format so value and audience are explicit.

custom_fields.name: Acceptance Criteria
custom_fields.description: Testable, bullet-listed conditions that define 'done' for this Story
custom_fields.help_text: Each criterion must be independently testable by QA.

custom_fields.name: Technical Approach
custom_fields.description: High-level implementation plan agreed with the Tech Lead
custom_fields.help_text: Outline the approach, key components touched, and any spikes needed.

custom_fields.name: BRD Reviewer
custom_fields.description: Tech Lead who reviewed and signed off the BRD / requirements
custom_fields.help_text: Set when the Tech Lead approves the requirements during BRD_REVIEW.

custom_fields.name: Story Points
custom_fields.note: May already exist as a JIRA built-in / agile field - the setup script checks first and skips if present.

custom_fields.name: BRD Document Link
custom_fields.description: Link to approved BRD (Google Docs or Confluence)
custom_fields.source: config/jira-custom-fields.json (Phase 1) - reference only, do not recreate

custom_fields.name: BRD Approved Date
custom_fields.description: Date the BRD was approved by stakeholders
custom_fields.source: config/jira-custom-fields.json (Phase 1) - reference only, do not recreate

definition_of_ready.description: All items below must be satisfied before a Story transitions BRD_REVIEW -> READY_FOR_DEV. The Railway middleware (app/rules/brd_gate.py::enforce_dor_gate) validates these and comments on violations; the JIRA Automation rule performs the actual transition block.
checklist: User Story written (As a... I want... so that...)

setup_instructions.step_1: Populate .env with JIRA_URL, JIRA_EMAIL, JIRA_API_TOKEN (never hardcode).
setup_instructions.step_3: Copy the printed field IDs into this file and config/jira-story-workflow.yaml.
setup_instructions.step_4: Associate the new fields with the Story Create/Edit/View screens.
setup_instructions.step_5: Proceed to create the Story workflow (config/jira-story-workflow.yaml).
